claim: Patchline ships an online-learning safety guard freezing any update that would weaken a soundness invariant. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the online-learning guard claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make online-learning-guard-gate`.
